title: Free filtration of the total complex of two-step split columns
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $K^{p,q}$ a bicomplex of $A$-modules, with commuting differentials $d_h:K^{p,q}\to K^{p+1,q}$ and $d_v:K^{p,q}\to K^{p,q+1}$ (each squaring to zero), whose columns are cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. Suppose every column $p>0$ is zero. For every $p\le0$ suppose there is a degreewise split short exact sequence of cochain complexes $0\to U_p\to B_p\to V_p\to0$, an isomorphism $B_p\cong K^{p,\bullet}$, and decompositions of $U_p$ and $V_p$ as direct sums of single-degree copies of $A$, indexed by sets in the universe of $A$. Let $T^n=\bigoplus_{p+q=n}K^{p,q}$ with differential $d_h+(-1)^p d_v$. Then there exist cochain complexes $F_n$ for $n\in\mathbf N$, monomorphisms $\iota_n:F_n\to T$, and maps $s_n:F_n\to F_{n+1}$, with $F_0=0$, $s_n\iota_{n+1}=\iota_n$, every element of every $T^k$ in the image of some $\iota_n^k$, every $s_n^k$ admitting a retraction, and every cokernel $\operatorname{coker}(s_n)$ isomorphic as a complex to a direct sum of single-degree copies of $A$ indexed in its universe. No exactness of the horizontal rows, augmentation, or quasi-isomorphism is assumed.

proof.text: Transport the chosen left term in column $-i$ to a subcomplex $U_i$ of that column. It and its quotient have zero differential, since their decompositions are sums of single-degree complexes. Set $F_0=0$. In total degree $k$, let $F_{2i+1}$ contain the full terms of columns $-j$ for $j<i$ and the term $U_i^{k+i}$ in column $-i$. Let $F_{2i+2}$ contain the full terms of columns $-j$ for $j\le i$, in vertical degree $k+j$.

The horizontal differential lowers $j$ by one, hence lands in an earlier full column; for $j=0$ it lands in a zero positive column. The vertical differential on $U_i$ vanishes and preserves each full column. Thus these submodules are subcomplexes and their inclusions are compatible and monic. Direct-sum elements have finite support, and all positive columns vanish. Taking $i$ at least every $j$ in the support places any element in $F_{2i+2}$; zero already lies in $F_0$.

The new piece of $F_{2i+1}/F_{2i}$ is $U_i$, with vertical degrees shifted in total degree by $-i$; that of $F_{2i+2}/F_{2i+1}$ is $V_i$ with the same degree adjustment. Horizontal differentials are zero on these quotients because they land in earlier columns, and vertical differentials are zero by the single-degree decompositions. A summand in vertical degree $d$ becomes a summand in total degree $d-i$. Projecting away new summands, and using the given degreewise splitting within column $-i$, gives retractions of the inclusions. This also handles the inclusion out of zero. These quotient identifications give the categorical cokernel isomorphisms.
